title: Dynamics 365 Business Central Blog Series: Adding Barcodes
summary: This blog series covers barcode functionality in Dynamics 365 Business Central, including one-dimensional and two-dimensional barcode generation in reports, barcode scanning through AL code, printing barcodes from production orders, and integrating external barcode services with Swiss QR Code and QR code capabilities.
key_points: The series covers 1D barcodes in reports (BC18) and 2D barcode fonts such as Aztec, Data Matrix, Maxi Code, PDF417 and QR (BC19.1)
External services or APIs can produce barcodes such as Telepen, Swiss QR and colored QR codes, and Swiss QR can also be generated without external services
Barcode scanning can be started from AL to add a Scan Barcode action with continuous scanning
Print and scan barcodes (BC23) and printing barcodes from production orders (BC26) work without customization
A QR code can hold a Business Central page URL, for example a customer card link
features: Two-dimensional barcodes (Aztec, Data Matrix, Maxi Code, PDF417, QR-Code)
